guide.teeming.dripfang.counter: When you hear or see the drip, step aside: it drops on the spot where you stood. A miss sticks its point in the ground for three seconds: its crown glows gold and it takes half again as much damage. Then it hauls itself back up.
guide.teeming.dripfang.home: Dripstone caves. It hangs from the ceiling among the real dripstone, one more stone fang.
guide.teeming.dripfang.role: A living stalactite. It waits on the ceiling for something to walk beneath it, then drops point-first.
guide.teeming.dripfang.tell: Water drips from its tip with a soft drip, and it shivers for just over half a second before it lets go.
guide.teeming.dunefin.counter: Stand on anything that isn't sand and it can't reach you. Step off the sand onto stone as its fin rises: it leaps after you, lands on the hard ground and lies stunned for three seconds.
guide.teeming.dunefin.home: Deserts, swimming under the sand in any light.
guide.teeming.dunefin.role: A sand shark. It swims through the sand with only its fin showing and hunts anyone standing on sand.
guide.teeming.dunefin.tell: Its fin rises out of the sand right under you for three quarters of a second. Then it breaches and bites.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.counter: Kill the alpha, the big one with the mane. When it dies the rest of the pack runs for ten seconds. Step aside from a dart when you see the crouch.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.home: Taiga forests at night, in packs of three or four.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.role: A dusk wolf pack that circles you and takes turns: only one hound darts in at a time, while the big maned alpha howls to speed the others up.
guide.teeming.gloamhound.tell: The hound whose turn it is crouches low and growls for a moment, then darts in to bite.
guide.teeming.hushwing.counter: Walk or sneak: it never hears quiet steps. Throw a snowball, egg or arrow away from you and the whole flock chases the impact for five seconds.
guide.teeming.hushwing.home: Deep caves below y 0, in flocks of three or four.
guide.teeming.hushwing.role: A blind cave bat. It cannot see you: it hears a sprint within sixteen blocks, a fight within twelve and mining within ten, flies to the noise and bites.
guide.teeming.hushwing.tell: No warning before a bite. When it hears something, its big ears snap up and flick and a ring of sound rises over it.
guide.teeming.levimoth.counter: Keep out of the cloud, above all near an island's edge. Slow Falling makes the drop afterwards harmless.
guide.teeming.levimoth.role: A dusky moth with a weak bite. Threaten it and it shakes out a cloud of dust that lifts whatever is inside.
guide.teeming.levimoth.tell: It flares its wings wide and its dust sacs pulse for a moment.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.counter: Step off the bubbles before they stop. If it swallows you, hit it three times, from inside or from outside: it spits you out and is stunned for two seconds, taking half again as much damage. Otherwise it chews on you for five seconds before it lets go.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.home: Swamps and mangrove swamps, lying hidden under shallow water.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.role: A wide-mouthed ambusher. Under the water nothing can see it, mobs can't target it and arrows go straight past it. A few bubbles are the only sign that it is there.
guide.teeming.mire_gulper.tell: Bubbles boil up from the water right under you for a second. Then it lunges up and swallows whatever is standing over it.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.counter: Fire. A shambler that is burning, or dies to fire, crumbles to ash with no burst and no spores. Otherwise step back from a falling one: the spores reach two blocks.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.home: Dark forests and caves, but never on the mushroom fields.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.role: A slow fungal shambler. When it dies it bursts into two smaller ones, and those burst again, each burst a puff of poison spores.
guide.teeming.mycelite_shambler.tell: It swings without warning. As it falls, its cap and spore sacs swell for a moment before it bursts.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.counter: Kill it first, from range if it runs. Hit it while its cap swells and the cap bursts early: no spores for the pack, and it reels for two seconds.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.home: Dark forests, among the big mushrooms.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.role: A little mushroom shepherd that keeps to the back of a fight. Every eight seconds it puffs spores that heal and hasten the monsters round it, and it runs from you if you come within six blocks.
guide.teeming.puffcap_shepherd.tell: Its cap swells up and sheds spores for a moment before the puff.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.counter: Back off. Once you are more than eight blocks away it calms down. Step within four blocks after the rattle and it strikes, and the bite poisons you.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.home: Badlands, out in the open in any light. A paler Sidewinder turns up in deserts now and then.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.role: A rattlesnake that wants to be left alone. It never hunts you, but it won't let you walk past it either.
guide.teeming.rattlecoil.tell: Come within six blocks and it coils, lifts its head and shakes its raised rattle for a second and a half.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.counter: Hit it with a shovel, or knock it back hard (a sprinting hit will do), to flip it onto its back. For three seconds it can't fight back and its belly takes double damage.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.home: Beaches and stony shores, in small groups.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.role: A crab that leaves you alone until you strike it. Its shell and claws turn every blow from the front, and then it pinches back.
guide.teeming.shellguard_crab.tell: It raises both claws and opens them for a moment before it pinches.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.counter: Get near heat: fire, a lit campfire or lava within three blocks of you snaps the beam. Or break its line of sight. Leather armour keeps the cold out, but it still heals.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.home: Snowy plains, ice spikes and frozen peaks, at night.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.role: A frost spirit that drains warmth through a beam. While the beam holds you freeze, and it heals.
guide.teeming.shiverwraith.tell: It raises its arms toward you and a thin frost beam flickers between you for a moment before it locks on.
guide.teeming.skreel.counter: Raise a shield into the dive. A blocked Skreel crashes and lies stunned for three seconds, taking half again as much damage. Or step out of the line.
guide.teeming.skreel.home: Windswept hills and stony and jagged peaks, by day or night.
guide.teeming.skreel.role: A mountain raptor that circles ten to twenty blocks above its prey and drops on it from the sky.
guide.teeming.skreel.tell: It stops in the air, tips nose-down and screeches for a second, and a line of wind points at you.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.counter: Cool it: a snowball takes off a little heat, splash water more, powder snow all of it. Cooled right down it is quenched for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.role: A slag golem that heats up as it fights. Its cracks glow brighter at each stage of heat.
guide.teeming.slagheart_golem.tell: At full heat it raises its arms and shakes for a second, then erupts: fire and heavy damage within five blocks.
guide.teeming.snagwood.counter: When it creaks, step behind it or out to one side: the sweep only covers three blocks across its front. An axe bites twice as deep. Leave it alone for eight seconds and it roots back into a snag.
guide.teeming.snagwood.home: Forests, but never the dark forest. It stands among the living trees as one more dead snag.
guide.teeming.snagwood.role: A dead tree that walks. Rooted, it looks like any broken snag until you come within five blocks. Then it tears its roots free and lumbers after you, slowly.
guide.teeming.snagwood.tell: It creaks, leans back and raises its dead limbs for just over half a second, bark dust falling, then sweeps its roots across the ground in front of it.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.counter: It turns slowly, so circle it. Step aside when the jaws open and the seed flies past. From behind, where the seed sac glows gold, your hits do double damage.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.home: Lush caves and the jungle floor.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.role: A rooted flower with a jaw for a head. It never leaves its spot, spits hard seeds at anything within fourteen blocks and bites whatever stands next to it.
guide.teeming.snapmaw_bloom.tell: Its jaws open for half a second with a glowing seed inside, then it spits or snaps.
guide.teeming.snowroller.counter: Step out of its line, or get a wall between you. A Snowroller that hits a wall lies stunned on its back for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.snowroller.home: Snowy slopes, groves and jagged peaks, after dark.
guide.teeming.snowroller.role: A snow beast that curls into a ball and rolls downhill at you, growing bigger and hitting harder the farther it rolls.
guide.teeming.snowroller.tell: It tucks its head and legs in and curls up for most of a second, puffing snow.
guide.teeming.stormeel.counter: Get out of the water while it glows: onto the shore, onto a block above the surface or into a boat, or swim more than five blocks away. On land it can only flop back towards the sea, and it dries out.
guide.teeming.stormeel.home: Warm and lukewarm oceans, in the water.
guide.teeming.stormeel.role: A slim eel that hunts swimmers. It stores a charge in the spots along its flanks and lets it go through the water around it.
guide.teeming.stormeel.tell: Its spots glow brighter and crackle with sparks for a second and a half, then it discharges: everything in the water within five blocks takes a heavy shock.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.counter: Step aside when it charges. If it runs into a wall it is stunned for three seconds and takes half again as much damage.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.role: A grazer that leaves you alone until one of the herd is hurt. Then they all turn on you.
guide.teeming.thornhorn.tell: It lowers its horns and paws the ground for a second.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.counter: Step out of the shadow before it lands. If it wraps you, you are slowed to a crawl and squeezed once a second for four seconds: cut it off with shears, or with a fully charged sword swing while you stand on the ground. It is knocked loose and lies stunned for three seconds, taking half again as much damage. Hit it while it hangs and it lets go and falls.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.home: Jungles, hanging upside down under the leaves of the canopy, up to twelve blocks above the ground.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.role: A knot of vines that waits in the trees for something to walk underneath. It creeps along the underside of the leaves to get above its prey, drops on it and wraps it up.
guide.teeming.vinedrop_strangler.tell: For just over half a second a dark ring of shadow shows on the ground where it will land, leaves fall and the canopy rustles. Then it drops.
item.teeming.chorus_silk.source: Dropped by Levimoths and chorus growths
item.teeming.chorus_silk.use: Brews an Awkward Potion into Slow Falling
item.teeming.frost_core.use: With a bucket, crafts into a powder snow bucket
item.teeming.heartwood.source: Dropped by Snagwoods, Vinedrop Stranglers and Snapmaw Blooms
item.teeming.heartwood.use: Crafts into 4 sticks; 2 craft into 3 bone meal
item.teeming.material.guide: Craft a Field Guide: a book and any Teeming material
item.teeming.sand_scale.source: Dropped by Dunefins and Shellguard Crabs
item.teeming.slag_gland.source: Dropped by Slagheart Golems, Slagspitters, Quakehoppers and Lavaleapers
item.teeming.spore_sac.source: Dropped by Puffcap Shepherds and Mycelite Shamblers
item.teeming.spore_sac.use: Brews an Awkward Potion into Regeneration
item.teeming.storm_coil.use: Brews an Awkward Potion into Water Breathing
item.teeming.venom_fang.use: Brews an Awkward Potion into Poison; With 8 arrows, crafts 8 Arrows of Poison
